correctness.rationale: The shared-pool payoffs equal r/(d+1) times two-hop group incidence minus the contribution cost. For every discordant edge, row-sum zero and fixed endpoint coefficients make the exact binary-affine extrema H and 2a-H attainable. This establishes a necessary and sufficient cutoff; local torus coefficients and the clique consequence are directly reconstructed. Exact rational tests cross-check 114 graph/rate instances and full free two-hop binary assignments for three torus sizes.

value.rationale: Identifies exactly when an experimentally varied payoff tolerance eliminates strategic selection from every possible local comparison, not merely from typical simulation states. The graph formula shows sharp dependence on overlapping two-hop neighborhood geometry, even for networks of the same degree, and the torus constant applies for every side length L>=6 and all positive r. The criterion is useful for calibration and for distinguishing exact neutral dynamics from a large-noise approximation.
